newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Gov appoints environmental secretary.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Gov appoints environmental secretary.

text.p: NEW YORK, Jan 22 (Reuter) Gov Howard Dean has appointed a former state prosecutor as Deputy Secretary of the Vermont Natural Resources Agency.
Dean appointed John Kassel to replace Elizabeth McLain, who is stepping down at the end of the month to become a vice-president of the Vermont Student Assistance Corporation.
Kassel has been general council at the environmental agency. Before that, he was a deputy state's attorney in Chittenden County.
